Author: Ehno, AllegroVivo
Name: XIV Venue Manager Sync (Dev)
Punchline: Test build of the XIV Venue Manager plugin. Talks to the dev API only.
Description: Test build of the XIV Venue Manager Sync plugin for the dev environment. It connects to dev-api.xivvenuemanager.com and never to the live service. Safe to install next to the normal plugin: it has its own settings, data and commands (/xvmdev).
Changelog: Dev build: link with a one-time code, setup checklist and character link, automatic venue matching by address, shift prompts, room controls, Bans tab, own leave and already-inside reporting. Only talks to the dev API and dev website.
